name: Moment Bounds for Measures
definition: A moment sequence $\mathbf{m} = (m_0, \dots, m_{2n})$ is strictly positive if for any non-negative polynomial $p(x) \ge 0$ (with $p \not\equiv 0$), the result of the operator $\mathfrak{S}_m\{p\} > 0$. This ensures the moments are consistent with a non-negative measure.
summary: Moment Bounds for Measures computes differentiable upper and lower bounds on cumulative mass by solving the truncated Hamburger moment problem, providing tighter results than Chebyshev's inequality through arbitrary moment sequences.
